scheme_name: Laptop Purchase Assistance Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
description:
The Laptop Purchase Assistance Scheme is an initiative launched by the Gujarat Labour Welfare Board to support the educational needs of children of registered construction workers in the state of Gujarat.

The scheme was officially launched on 1st January 2021 as part of the government's broader efforts to enhance educational opportunities for children from economically disadvantaged backgrounds.

The primary objective of the Laptop Purchase Assistance Scheme is to provide financial assistance for the purchase of laptops to children of construction workers who are registered under the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Workers Act, 1996.

The scheme aims to bridge the digital divide and ensure that children have access to technology that is essential for their education in the modern digital age.

Under this scheme, eligible beneficiaries can receive a one-time financial assistance amount of ₹20,000 for the purchase of a laptop.

The scheme is designed to benefit children who are studying in classes 9 to 12 in recognized educational institutions.

To be eligible for the Laptop Purchase Assistance Scheme, applicants must meet specific criteria.

The applicant must be a child of a registered construction worker in Gujarat.

The construction worker must be registered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.

The applicant must be studying in a recognized school or college and must be in classes 9 to 12.

There is no specific income limit mentioned for the construction worker to qualify for this scheme.

The application process for the Laptop Purchase Assistance Scheme involves several steps.

First, the applicant must obtain the application form from the official website of the Gujarat Labour Welfare Board or from the local Labour Welfare Office.

The completed application form must be submitted along with necessary documents.

Required documents include a copy of the construction worker's registration certificate, proof of the applicant's educational enrollment, and identity proof of the applicant.

Once the application is submitted, it will be reviewed by the concerned authorities.

The authorities will verify the details provided in the application along with the documents submitted.

If the application is approved, the financial assistance amount will be disbursed directly to the bank account of the applicant or the construction worker.

The disbursement of funds typically occurs within 30 days of the application approval.

The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat Labour Welfare Board under the Department of Labour and Employment, Government of Gujarat.

The contact details for the Gujarat Labour Welfare Board can be found on their official website.

The board is responsible for overseeing the implementation of various welfare schemes for labourers in the state.

The Laptop Purchase Assistance Scheme is part of a larger framework of initiatives aimed at improving the welfare of construction workers and their families.

The scheme recognizes the importance of digital literacy in education and aims to empower students with the necessary tools for their academic success.

Since its launch, the scheme has seen a positive response from beneficiaries who have expressed gratitude for the support provided.

The initiative is aligned with the national goal of promoting digital education and ensuring that no child is left behind in the technological advancement of education.

The Gujarat government has allocated a substantial budget for the implementation of this scheme to ensure that it reaches the intended beneficiaries.

The scheme is expected to benefit thousands of children across the state of Gujarat.

In the first year of its implementation, the scheme aimed to provide assistance to at least 10,000 students.

The Gujarat Labour Welfare Board has set up a dedicated team to handle inquiries and provide support to applicants throughout the application process.

The scheme also emphasizes the importance of education in improving the socio-economic status of families involved in construction work.

By facilitating access to laptops, the scheme aims to enhance the learning experience of students and prepare them for future challenges.

The Laptop Purchase Assistance Scheme is a significant step towards achieving educational equity in Gujarat.

The government encourages eligible families to take advantage of this scheme to ensure their children have the necessary resources for their education.

The scheme is part of a broader strategy to improve the living standards of construction workers and their families in Gujarat.

The Gujarat Labour Welfare Board continuously monitors the implementation of the scheme to ensure transparency and efficiency.

Feedback from beneficiaries is collected to make necessary improvements to the scheme.

The scheme also serves as a model for other states to consider similar initiatives for their labour force.

The Gujarat government remains committed to enhancing the welfare of its citizens through various targeted schemes.

The Laptop Purchase Assistance Scheme is an example of how government initiatives can directly impact the lives of individuals and families.

In conclusion, the Laptop Purchase Assistance Scheme by the Gujarat Labour Welfare Board is a vital program aimed at providing financial assistance for laptop purchases to children of registered construction workers.

The scheme not only supports educational needs but also promotes digital literacy among the youth of Gujarat.

Through this initiative, the government aims to empower the next generation and ensure they are equipped with the necessary tools for success in an increasingly digital world.
